verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at activepieces.com/llms.txt that returns HTTP 200 with a curated product summary. The cited documentation pages are served as per-page markdown (.md) URLs, which agents can consume directly. Missing for 10: an llms-full.txt or single docs markdown bundle (docs.md returns 404), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
